_about: Corrections applied to Cliopatria v0.2.1 before the atlas is built. Years are inclusive; negative years are B.C. Each rule is applied in the order listed: drop, rename, fill, cut, subtract, occupy, contest. Then the automatic passes run (postwar overlaps, nested realms, coastal gaps).

rename.name: First Hellenic Republic

rename.name: Federated Republic of Germany
rename.why: Correct name

rename.name: Kuomintang
rename.why: These shapes are all of China, the internationally recognized Republic

rename.name: Kuomintang
rename.why: The Kuomintang government in the south before the Northern Expedition ended

rename.name: Kuomintang
rename.why: China reunified under the Nationalists in 1928

rename.name: Estado Novo
rename.why: Estado Novo began 1933

rename.name: Kingdom of Naples (Napoleonic)
rename.why: The Napoleonic kingdom existed only 1806-1815

rename.name: Sultanate of Malacca
rename.why: Malacca fell to Portugal in 1511; its heirs ruled from Johor

rename.name: Assyrian Egypt
rename.why: Psamtik I threw off Assyrian rule by 656 B.C.

rename.name: Confederation of the Rhine
rename.why: This shape is the post-Tilsit Kingdom of Prussia (Berlin to East Prussia, sample point near Berlin); Prussia was never a member of the Confederation of the Rhine.

rename.name: German Confederation
rename.why: This shape is Prussia (Rhineland to East Prussia, sample point east of Berlin), while the Kingdom of Prussia entry shows only tiny enclaves after 1807; East Prussia was not even inside the German Conf

rename.name: Denmark-Norway
rename.why: Denmark-Norway ended in 1814 (Treaty of Kiel); from 1814 the shape is Denmark with Iceland, the Faroes and Greenland only.

rename.name: Swedish Empire
rename.why: The 'Swedish Empire' (great-power era) ended in 1721 with the Treaty of Nystad; afterwards it is simply the Kingdom of Sweden.

rename.name: Republic of Florence
rename.why: The Republic of Florence ended in 1532 when Alessandro de' Medici became duke.

rename.name: Republic of Florence
rename.why: From 1569 Florence was the Grand Duchy of Tuscany, not a republic.

rename.name: County of Savoy
rename.why: Savoy was raised to a duchy in 1416.

rename.name: House of Savoy
rename.why: A dynasty name is used for the state; the polity in 1564-1720 was the Duchy of Savoy (Piedmont-Savoy).

rename.name: Bourbon Kingdom of France
rename.why: The Bourbon Restoration ended with the July Revolution of 1830; 1830-1848 is the Orléanist July Monarchy.

rename.name: (Bourbon Kingdom of France)
rename.why: Same composite after 1830 is the July Monarchy, not the Bourbon kingdom.

rename.name: Batavian Republic
rename.why: The Batavian Republic became the Kingdom of Holland under Louis Bonaparte in 1806.

rename.name: (Batavian Republic)
rename.why: Same change for the composite.

rename.name: Italian Republic
rename.why: The Italian Republic became the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy in March 1805.

rename.name: Cispadane Republic
rename.why: The Cispadane Republic existed only 1796-1797 before merging into the Cisalpine Republic, which was restored in 1800-1802.

rename.name: Helvetic Republic
rename.why: The Act of Mediation replaced the Helvetic Republic with the Swiss Confederation in 1803.

rename.name: Septinsular Republic
rename.new: United States of the Ionian Islands
rename.why: After 1815 the islands were the British-protected United States of the Ionian Islands.

rename.name: Septinsular Republic
rename.why: The Septinsular Republic ended in 1807 when the islands passed to France (Tilsit).

rename.name: Kingdom of Hanover
rename.why: The Kingdom of Hanover was created only in 1814; in 1803-1804 it was the (French-occupied) Electorate.

rename.name: Empire of Haiti
rename.why: The First Empire ended in 1806; Haiti was then a republic (south) and State/Kingdom of Haiti (north) until unification as the Republic in 1820.

rename.name: Empire of Haiti
rename.why: The Second Empire ended in 1859; 1860-1915 is the Republic of Haiti.

rename.name: Kingdom of Monaco
rename.why: Monaco was never a kingdom; it is a principality and duplicates the 'Principality of Monaco' entry.

rename.name: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia
rename.why: Romania became a kingdom in 1881.

rename.name: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia
rename.why: From the 1866 constitution the state was officially Romania (Principality of Romania).

rename.name: Principality of Bulgaria
rename.why: Bulgaria declared independence as a tsardom (kingdom) in 1908.

rename.name: Serbs
rename.why: An ethnic name is used for a state; 1804-1813 is the First Serbian Uprising state.

rename.name: Serbs
rename.why: The state 1815-1882 was the Principality of Serbia.

rename.name: Serbs
rename.why: Serbia became a kingdom in 1882.

rename.name: Natalia Republic
rename.why: The Boer Natalia Republic was annexed by Britain in 1843; afterwards it is the Colony of Natal.

rename.name: Argentine Confederation
rename.why: The Argentine Confederation ended in 1861 (Pavón); the state was the Argentine Republic thereafter.

rename.name: Republic of Colombia
rename.why: Colombia was the United States of Colombia 1863-1886; the Republic dates from 1886.

rename.name: People's Republic of Zanzibar
rename.why: The 1856-1889 rows are the Sultanate of Zanzibar; the People's Republic existed only in 1964.

rename.name: Omani Slave Coast
rename.why: 'Slave Coast' is the West African Bight of Benin; these are the Omani sultanate's Swahili-coast possessions.

rename.name: Belgian Congo
rename.why: Before 1908 the territory was Leopold II's Congo Free State.

rename.name: Belgian Congo
rename.why: The 1960-1962 rows are a small shape in Rwanda/Burundi (Belgian trust territory), not the Congo.

rename.name: British Gold Coast
rename.why: From c.1900 the shape includes Nigeria (sample point in Nigeria, area ~1.2M km2 vs Gold Coast ~240k); in 1958-1960 it is Nigeria alone after Ghana's independence.

rename.name: British East Africa
rename.why: The 1961-1968 shape is centred on the Rhodesias and spans southern/west Africa (sample point in Zambia/Zimbabwe), and keeps Kenya and Uganda after independence.

rename.name: Mali Federation
rename.why: The Mali Federation lasted only 1959-1960; after Senegal left it was the Republic of Mali.

rename.name: Burkina Faso
rename.why: The country was Upper Volta until 1984.

rename.name: Republic of Benin
rename.why: The country was Dahomey until 1975.

rename.name: Tanzania
rename.why: Tanzania formed from Tanganyika and Zanzibar only in Apr 1964.

rename.name: Hungarian Republic
rename.why: Interwar Hungary was a kingdom under Regent Horthy, not a republic.

rename.name: Kingdom of Lithuania
rename.why: The Kingdom of Lithuania existed only on paper in 1918; interwar Lithuania was a republic.

rename.name: Republic of Poland
rename.why: Poland was the Polish People's Republic until the end of 1989.

rename.name: Kingdom of Cambodia
rename.why: Cambodia was the Khmer Republic Oct 1970-Apr 1975.

rename.name: Khmer Rouge
rename.why: The Khmer Rouge is the movement; the state was Democratic Kampuchea.

rename.name: People's Republic of Kampuchea
rename.why: The monarchy was restored in 1993 (and 1989-1992 was the State of Cambodia).

rename.name: Papua New Guinea
rename.new: Territory of Papua and New Guinea
rename.why: Papua New Guinea became independent only in 1975; before that it was Australian-administered.

rename.name: Qatar Protectorate
rename.why: This shape is Oman (sample point at 57.1E 20.9N, 308k km2), not Qatar.

rename.name: Sri Lanka
rename.why: The island was the Dominion of Ceylon until it became Sri Lanka in 1972.

rename.name: Islamic Republic of Pakistan
rename.why: Pakistan was a dominion until the 1956 constitution created the Islamic Republic.

rename.name: Republic of India
rename.why: India was a dominion until the constitution took effect on 26 Jan 1950.

rename.name: Zimbabwe Rhodesia
rename.why: Zimbabwe Rhodesia lasted June-Dec 1979; Zimbabwe became independent in April 1980.

rename.name: Serbia-Montenegro
rename.why: The state was the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia until it was renamed Serbia and Montenegro in 2003.

rename.name: Federated Republic of Brazil
rename.why: The official name from 1967 was República Federativa do Brasil (Federative Republic).

rename.name: Libyan Arab Republic
rename.why: Libya was renamed the (Great Socialist People's) Libyan Arab Jamahiriya in 1977; after 2011 it is the State of Libya.

rename.name: Eswatini
rename.why: The country was renamed Eswatini only in 2018.

rename.name: Socialist Republic of Romania
rename.why: Romania was the People's Republic until 1965.

rename.name: People's Republic of Angola
rename.why: Angola dropped 'People's' in 1992.

rename.name: Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia
rename.why: Renamed North Macedonia in Feb 2019.

rename.name: Kingdom of Bahrain
rename.why: Bahrain became a kingdom only in 2002.

rename.name: Guayaquil Junta
rename.why: The shape is highland Ecuador around Quito; Guayaquil stayed royalist until 1820, and the 1811-1812 insurgent polity was the State of Quito.

rename.name: Netherlands Antilles
rename.why: The Netherlands Antilles was created in 1954; before that the shape (which includes Suriname) was the colonies of Surinam and Curaçao.

rename.name: Poles
rename.why: An ethnic name is used for the insurgent state of 1830-1831 (Congress Poland in revolt).

rename.name: Khmer Empire
rename.why: The Khmer Empire ended with the abandonment of Angkor c.1431; later rows are the post-Angkor Kingdom of Cambodia.

rename.name: Astrakhan Khanate
rename.why: The Astrakhan Khanate was annexed by Russia in 1556; the 1642-1768 rows are the Don Cossack Host shape (same as the 'Don Cossacks' entry).

rename.name: Kingdom of Pajana
rename.why: Misspelling; the central Javanese state of 1568-1586 is Pajang.

rename.name: First Toungoo Empire
rename.why: The First Toungoo Empire collapsed in 1599; 1599-1752 is the Restored Toungoo (Nyaungyan) dynasty.

rename.name: Konbaung Dynasty
rename.why: Konbaung was founded in 1752 in Upper Burma; the 1741-1751 shape is Pegu (Lower Burma), the Restored Hanthawaddy Kingdom.

rename.name: Maratha Empire
rename.why: The Maratha Confederacy ended in 1818; the 1820-1845 shape around Gwalior/Malwa is the Scindia princely state.

rename.name: Sur Empire
rename.why: The Sur Empire fell in 1556; the later shapes are Bengal and Odisha under the Karrani Afghans (1564-1576) and their remnants.

rename.name: New France
rename.why: Same rows need a label for the French West Indies and Guiana.

rename.name: New Netherland
rename.why: Post-1664 shapes are Suriname, Berbice and Essequibo plus Dutch Caribbean posts.

rename.name: Hashemite Arab Federation
rename.why: 'Hashemite Arab Federation' is the 1958 Iraq-Jordan union; this 15th-century lower-Iraq shape matches the Jalayirid rump state (Hillah, Wasit, Basra), destroyed by the Qara Qoyunlu in 1432.

rename.name: East Turkestan
rename.why: 'East Turkestan' is a modern regional term; in 1462-1474 the Tarim region was the eastern part of divided Moghulistan.

rename.name: Livonian Conference
rename.why: Garbled name; the polity is the Livonian Confederation.

rename.name: Gorkha Kingdom
rename.why: After Prithvi Narayan Shah took Kathmandu in 1768 Gorkha became the Kingdom of Nepal; the dataset's Nepal entry overlaps it 1775-1787.

rename.name: Kingdom of Bhutan
rename.why: The hereditary Kingdom of Bhutan dates from 1907; earlier it was the Zhabdrung theocratic state.

rename.name: Small Horde
rename.why: The polity is the Lesser (Kichi) Nogai Horde; 'Small Horde' normally means the Kazakh Junior Zhuz.

rename.name: Đại Việt
rename.why: These rows are a tiny shape at Phan Rang (108.9E 11.8N), the last Cham principality (Thuận Thành), not Đại Việt; Champa itself wrongly ends in 1652.

rename.name: Napoleonic Batavia Republic
rename.why: Garbled label for the Cape under Batavian rule 1803-1806.

rename.name: Nicaean Empire
rename.why: After retaking Constantinople in 1261 the Nicaean state was the restored Byzantine Empire.

rename.name: Caliphate of Córdoba
rename.why: The Caliphate was abolished in 1031; the small Córdoba-only rows after that are the Jahwarid taifa.

rename.name: County of Ribagorza
rename.why: The shape sits around Pamplona (1.9W 42.9N) and in 1034-1039 covers Sancho III's realm (172k km2); Ribagorza was a small Pyrenean county.

rename.name: County of Urgell
rename.why: The 1279-1808 rows are a ~400 km2 shape at Andorra (1.6E 42.5N); Urgell was annexed by Aragon in 1413, while Andorra dates from the 1278 paréage.

rename.name: Mahdids
rename.why: Labels are swapped: this shape is in Oman, ruled by the Nabhani dynasty; the Mahdids ruled Zabid in Yemen.

rename.name: Nabhani Dynasty
rename.why: Labels are swapped: this Yemen shape (continuing the Najahid shape) is the Mahdid state of Zabid (1159-1174).

rename.name: Almohad Caliphate
rename.why: The Almohads lost Marrakesh to the Marinids in 1269; the 1260-1343 Morocco shape is identical to the Marinid shape, which has a gap in exactly these years.

rename.name: Ngô Dynasty
rename.why: The Ngô dynasty ended in 965; Đinh Bộ Lĩnh founded Đại Cồ Việt in 968.

rename.name: Ngô Dynasty
rename.why: Vietnam was ruled by the Early Lê 980-1009.

rename.name: Ngô Dynasty
rename.why: Vietnam (Đại Việt) was ruled by the Lý 1009-1225.

rename.name: Ngô Dynasty
rename.why: Đại Việt was ruled by the Trần 1225-1400.

rename.name: Ngô Dynasty
rename.why: Hồ Quý Ly's Đại Ngu 1400-1407.

rename.name: Chámpa
rename.why: Garbled spelling with a stray accent.

rename.name: Serbian Empire
rename.why: The Serbian Empire dissolved in 1371; the 1375-1401 shape is Prince Lazar's Moravian Serbia.

rename.name: Serbian Empire
rename.why: 1402-1459 is the Serbian Despotate.

rename.name: Kingdom of Serbia
rename.why: Serbia became a kingdom with Stefan's coronation in 1217.

rename.name: Kingdom of Georgia
rename.why: The united Georgian kingdom split in 1490; these rows (43-46E around Tbilisi) are Kartli, and the 'Kingdom of Kartli' entry fills the gaps.

rename.name: Kingdom of Georgia
rename.why: 1762-1801 is the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti.

rename.name: Kingdom of Bosnia
rename.why: Bosnia fell to the Ottomans in 1463; the 1463-1481 shape is Herzegovina (Duchy of Saint Sava), which fell in 1482.

rename.name: Electorate of Trier
rename.why: The shape covers the Rhenish and Upper Palatinate (7.0-13.0E, sample point near Amberg) and excludes Trier itself (6.6E).

rename.name: Duchy of Styria
rename.why: The shape is a small territory at Gorizia (13.4E 46.1N), whose counts died out in 1500; Styria lies at 13.6-16.2E.

rename.name: Duchy of Styria
rename.why: The 1260-1271 shape is Tyrol (10.1-13.6E, sample point near Innsbruck).

rename.name: County of Brabant
rename.why: Brabant was a duchy from 1183.

rename.name: County of Blôis
rename.why: Misspelling.

rename.name: Principality of Polotsky
rename.why: Garbled (adjectival) form of Polotsk.

rename.name: Halych-Volhynia occupation
rename.why: The shape is the Pontic steppe (22-39E, 44-50N) held by the Cumans until the Mongol invasion; Galicia-Volhynia formed only in 1199 and lay further north.

rename.name: Barghawata Conference
rename.why: Garbled name.

rename.name: Jaemtland
rename.why: Garbled spelling.

rename.name: Chüzan
rename.why: Wrong diacritic (macron, not umlaut).

rename.name: Sind-Habbari Dynasty
rename.why: The Habbari emirate ended with Mahmud of Ghazni's conquest c.1026; later Sindh rows are the Soomra period.

rename.name: (Holy Roman Empire)
rename.why: The Holy Roman Empire dates from Otto I's coronation in 962; the 922-961 composite contains only the Kingdom of Germany.

rename.name: Holy Roman Empire
rename.why: The 1619-1621 plain row covers Bohemia, Silesia and the Palatinate, Frederick V's realm during the Bohemian Revolt, not the Empire.

rename.name: Kingdom of Castile
rename.why: Castile was a county until Ferdinand I took the royal title.

rename.name: Kingdom of Poland
rename.why: Poland became a kingdom with Bolesław I's coronation in 1025.

rename.name: Novgorod Republic
rename.why: The Novgorod Republic is conventionally dated from the expulsion of Prince Vsevolod in 1136.

rename.name: House of Jagiellon
rename.why: A dynasty name stands in for the Polish-Lithuanian union, so Poland and Lithuania vanish as named states 1450-1571.

rename.name: Lower Burgundy
rename.why: The 860-869 shape runs from Provence to Frisia (Lotharingia plus Provence), the Middle Frankish kingdoms, not Lower Burgundy.

rename.name: Western Jin
rename.why: Western Jin ended in 316; the southern state 317-420 is Eastern Jin.

rename.name: Later Jin
rename.why: Later Jin was 936-947; the 911-921 shape in northern Shanxi is Li Cunxu's Jin, the Later Tang precursor (the dataset's 'Former Jin').

rename.name: Later Han
rename.why: Later Han fell to Later Zhou in 951.

rename.name: Southern Wu
rename.why: Wu was replaced by Southern Tang in 937.

rename.name: Later Jin Dynasty
rename.why: Hong Taiji renamed Later Jin as Qing in 1636.

rename.name: Georgia
rename.why: Before unification in 1008 this western Georgian shape is the Kingdom of Abkhazia.

rename.name: Georgia
rename.why: The 724-777 shape is coastal Abkhazia (40.5E 43.4N), a Byzantine-allied principality.

rename.name: Georgia
rename.why: The 638-646 shape is Kartli (Iberia).

rename.name: Georgia
rename.why: The 567-576 shape is western Georgia, i.e. Lazica.

rename.name: Frisia Kingdom
rename.why: The shape is in Swabia/Alsace (sample point 8.9E 48.6N), identical to the later 'Kingdom of Alamannia' shape; Frisia lies 500 km north.

rename.name: Türgesh
rename.why: The 4M km2 Mongolia-centred shape (sample point 94.3E 44.9N) is the Second Turkic Khaganate; the Türgesh were in Zhetysu.

rename.name: Turks
rename.why: This Zhetysu/Talas shape (72.9E 41.7N) matches the Türgesh khaganate (699-766).

rename.name: Kingdom of Armenia
rename.why: The Arsacid kingdom was abolished in 428; afterwards Armenia was a Sasanian marzpanate.

rename.name: Kingdom of Armenia
rename.why: The 638-646 rows are the early Arab-period Principality of Armenia.

rename.name: Himyarite Kingdom
rename.why: Himyar fell to Aksum in 525 and Yemen was Sasanian from c.570.

rename.name: Wihtgar
rename.why: Wihtgar is a legendary king; the polity is the Wihtwara kingdom.

rename.name: Kingdom of Italy
rename.why: The 587-774 rows are the Lombard kingdom; the medieval Kingdom of Italy begins after Charlemagne's conquest of 774.

rename.name: Duchy of Benevento
rename.why: Arechis II made Benevento a principality in 774.

rename.name: Protectorate of the Western Regions
rename.why: The Han protectorate (and Jin chief officials) were long gone by the 5th-6th centuries, when the Tarim states answered to the Rouran, Hephthalites and Turks.

rename.name: Byeonhan
rename.why: Byeonhan developed into the Gaya confederacy by the 3rd-4th century; Gaya fell to Silla in 562.

rename.name: Duchy of Bavaria
rename.why: Bavaria received the electoral dignity in 1623.

rename.name: Later Zhou
rename.why: The -750 to -257 rows are the Eastern Zhou royal domain at Luoyang; Later Zhou was a Five Dynasties state of 951-960.

rename.name: Zhai
rename.why: The -208/-207 row is a 1.6M km2 shape covering most of China, i.e. the collapsing Qin dynasty; Zhai was a small Shaanxi kingdom (its 1-row 26k km2 shape follows).

rename.name: Great Yuan
rename.why: The Fergana state is known as Dayuan; 'Great Yuan' collides with the Yuan dynasty (and the wiki link points to it).

rename.name: New Kingdom of Egypt
rename.why: The New Kingdom ended c.1070 BC; -1000 to -801 is the Third Intermediate Period (21st/22nd Dynasties).

rename.name: Hyksos
rename.why: The Hyksos were expelled c.1550 BC; this Levant-only shape is the Canaanite city-states under Egyptian hegemony.

rename.name: Ptolemaic Kingdom
rename.why: These rows are Alexander's empire (the -326/-324 row reaches the Indus, sample point in Iran), while 'Macedonian Empire' shows only Macedon; the Ptolemaic kingdom dates from 305 BC.

rename.name: Sacred Band of Thebes
rename.why: The Sacred Band was a military unit, not a state.

rename.name: Italian City-States
rename.why: The label suggests medieval Italy; these are the Italian allies in revolt against Rome, 91-88 BC.

rename.name: (Phoenician Empire)
rename.why: There was no Phoenician empire; Phoenicia was a set of independent city-states.

rename.name: Mahajanapadas
rename.why: A period name is used for one row that continues the Vajji shape at the same spot.

rename.name: Estado Novo
rename.why: Carnation Revolution 1974

rename.name: Kingdom of England
rename.why: Acts of Union 1707

rename.name: Taliban
rename.why: The Taliban fell in late 2001

rename.name: Mujahideen
rename.why: Najibullah's government held Kabul until April 1992

rename.name: Mujahideen
rename.why: The mujahideen government 1992-1996

rename.name: Mujahideen
rename.why: These rows are eastern and northern Syria outside government control, unrelated to the Afghan mujahideen

rename.name: Russian Republic
rename.why: The Russian Republic ended in January 1918

rename.name: New Caledonia
rename.why: The shape spans French possessions from Reunion to Cochinchina

rename.name: Mughal Empire
rename.why: These late shapes lie over Rajputana; the Mughal emperor held little beyond Delhi

rename.name: Netherlands Antilles
rename.why: The Netherlands Antilles dissolved in 2010

rename.name: (Carolingian Empire)
rename.why: The Carolingian Empire broke up in 887-888

rename.name: South Africa
rename.why: Republic from 1961

rename.name: Éire
rename.why: Republic of Ireland Act 1949

rename.name: Hungarian Nationalists
rename.why: The 1956 revolution lasted weeks; the state remained the Hungarian People's Republic

rename.name: Hungarian Nationalists
rename.why: The revolutionary Hungarian State of 1849

rename.name: Communist Cuba
rename.why: Official name

rename.name: People's Socialist Republic of Albania
rename.why: Renamed in 1976

rename.name: Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia
rename.why: Renamed in 1963

rename.name: Kingdom of Bulgaria
rename.why: The monarchy was abolished in September 1946

fill.name: Republic of China
fill.why: The Beiyang government held the north while the Nationalists held the south

cut.name: Kingdom of Spain
cut.why: Spain lost its Italian lands at Utrecht

cut.name: Kingdom of Spain
cut.why: Spain lost its Italian lands at Utrecht; Naples and Sicily were a separate Bourbon kingdom from 1734
